summary: PayPay Corp filed a 6-K on July 31, 2026, announcing a business and capital alliance with Seven i Holdings and SEVEN-ELEVEN JAPAN. PayPay and SoftBank will subscribe for Seven i treasury shares via a third-party allotment, forming a strategic partnership in digital services. The filing lacks specific terms such as stake size, price per share, or implied value. Initiatives include integrating 7iD with PayPay ID and introducing PayPay Points. The alliance aims to combine PayPay's 75 million users with Seven i's 20,000+ stores. What to watch: regulatory approvals and equity pricing details.
